title: DecoyPosition
description: A single decoy chess puzzle record in decoy_positions.jsonl

fen.description: 4-part FEN of the position before the opponent's move (board, turn, castling, en passant)

opponentMove.description: UCI string of the opponent's move that leads to the puzzle position the player must solve

bestCp.description: Centipawn score of the best reply, normalised to the side to move (positive = good for solver)

depth.description: Engine search depth at which the evaluation was computed

acceptedMoves.description: All moves within CLUSTER_CP of the best move — any one is accepted as a correct answer

uci.description: UCI string of the move (e.g. e2e4)

line.description: Full engine PV line starting with this move

cp.description: Centipawn score of this move, normalised to the side to move

dropCp.description: Centipawn drop from the best move (0 for the best move itself)

source.description: Source tag for the game this position was drawn from (e.g. otb_master)

moveNumber.description: Half-move number within the source game when this position occurs

lichessGameUrl.description: URL to a Lichess game where this position appears (for reference)
